historical_diagnostic.independence_assessment: All ten files and their metadata/outcomes were already locally visible and used in historical development/evaluation. They remain valid for exact reproduction and causal diagnosis, but repartitioning cannot create fresh replication or a hidden final set.

same_class_replication.required_identity: fresh independently recorded Wind Tunnel Mk1 standard-configuration load_in changepoint traces generated under the same protocol and legal observation boundary
forbidden_substitutes: new runner permutations of load_in_seed_8 and load_in_seed_9
new overlapping windows from any existing file
moving existing train/development files into a renamed final split
wt_walks_v1 random walks or waveform runs
same_class_replication.resolution: A later, separately authorized action must acquire fresh physical traces without outcome-guided selection and hash-bind their protocol, license and split before access; otherwise WT-01 must remain diagnostic-only.

adversarial_candidate.metadata: Ten 10,000-measurement actuator-random-walk seeds, repeated slow/fast waveform runs, and two 320,000-observation regime-jump recordings are documented by the primary source.
adversarial_candidate.why_adversarial: It changes the actuation schedule and duration while retaining the same physical apparatus/configuration. This probes robustness to a harder operation but cannot reproduce the changepoint task.
preconditions: separate user-authorized bounded download with pre/post free-space checks and verified checksum
outcome-blind experiment/run split frozen before arrays are loaded
one mechanically defined legal control/response interface without file-name, semantic target or future-schedule leakage
horizon, metric, effect threshold and source-identical controls frozen before scoring

decision: Freeze the mechanism semantics now. Do not activate scoring. In WT-01 service cycle 2 either hash-bind genuinely fresh same-protocol physical traces or explicitly narrow the program to historical diagnosis plus a separately preregistered different-operation adversarial test.
